source.title: Fix decoding of C.LI, C.LUI, C.SRLI, C.SRAI, C.SSLI
source.intent: In the compressed instruction decoder, several RISC-V compressed HINT encodings are being reported as illegal instructions. In the RISC-V C extension, these encodings are legal HINT/no-op forms: `C.LI` with destination register `x0`, `C.LUI` with destination register `x0` and a non-zero immediate (for example `0x7065`), and `C.SRLI`, `C.SRAI`, or `C.SLLI` with shift amount `0`. Ibex currently treats these compressed instructions as illegal instead of recognizing them as valid compressed HINTs. The bug affects `ibex_compressed_decoder` whenever one of those specific HINT forms is presented. The expected behavior is that these instructions are still recognized as compressed instructions and do not raise the illegal-instruction indication.
